title: Identification of the object of the dual canonical Hopf bimodule with the dual distinguished invertible object
difficulty_reason: After the earlier distinguished invertibility and categorical module comparison are supplied, the new claim identifies D determined by the dual canonical algebra A* with X_ρ*. The author computes Hom(P₀⊠X_i,A*) in two ways, proving inside the second calculation that (P₀⊠1)⊗A is injective, decomposing it into external products of injective hulls with explicit multiplicities, and selecting the unique relevant socle/top label to identify D. The two calculations and the necessary injectivity lemma are charged as one H2. Neither the earlier construction of X_ρ nor ordinary Hopf module reconstruction supplies this comparison.

source_roles.source_scope: Original finite tensor category C over k. Canonical algebra A in C⊠C^op, D as in (7.59) determined by the Hopf bimodule A*, and distinguished invertible object X_ρ as in §6.4. The object D is isomorphic to X_ρ*. Keep this objectwise assertion, all original hypotheses and left/right duals.
source_roles.source_label_caveat: The original (7.58) prints coev_A for the final arrow M*⊗A*⊗A→M*, and the surrounding line calls it coevaluation. The typed arrow is not supplied by that label. The candidate does not select this displayed restatement as a necessary proof. The author already explicitly cites the same dual module structure in the last sentence of Remark7.8.6(i): if M is a left A-module then M* is a right A-module. The separately located original (7.59) uses that given structure. Retain (7.58) literally in the section and mark it as adjacent diagnostic, without a repaired source formula. Fixed errata has no correction for (7.58).
